description: Modular grid-snapping curation-station kit — tiling walls, step-stages, plinths, pillars, and a composer that stages 1-5 artifacts on the 1 m grid. Shares the HangarKit sci-fi-lab look.

station_wall.name: Station Wall (modular)
station_wall.description: A grid-modular backing wall exactly length_cells metres wide (1 m per cell) with optional start/end caps, so sections butt edge-to-edge on the grid and read as one continuous wall.

parameters.length_cells: Wall length in 1 m grid cells (int, default 2)
parameters.lit_seam: Emissive seam line along the top (bool)

station_stage.name: Station Stage (step deck)
station_stage.description: A grid-modular raised deck exactly width_cells x depth_cells metres, with a panelled skirt and caution-striped front lip — the platform a curated set stands on.

parameters.width_cells: Stage width in 1 m cells (int, default 5)
parameters.depth_cells: Stage depth in 1 m cells (int, default 3)
parameters.hazard_edge: Caution stripe on the front lip (bool)

station_plinth.name: Station Plinth (display column)
station_plinth.description: A grid-modular display plinth at ANY footprint — width_cells x depth_cells (1x1, 1x2, 1x3, 2x2, 3x3, 4x4 …) with per-cell panels and a tray cap. Tall+narrow for small things, low+broad for big ones; one artifact stands on each.

parameters.depth_cells: Footprint depth in 1 m cells (Z) — any combo, e.g. 1x2, 2x3, 4x4
parameters.top_height: Cap-top height where the artifact sits (≈1.0 m for small, lower for big plinths)

station_micropod.name: Station Micro-Pedestal (sub-1 m post)
station_micropod.description: A slim sub-grid pedestal (~0.6 m foot) for genuinely sub-1 m precious things — a held instrument, a thin readout — so the base no longer over-claims a full 1 m cell. Still snaps to one cell; same surface-pinned caption plate + detailing as station_plinth, built small via base_meters.

parameters.base_meters: Sub-grid foot width in metres (default 0.6) — the micro-pedestal size
parameters.top_height: Cap-top height where the artifact sits (≈1.1 m, eye level for a small thing)
parameters.caption_text: The artifact's display name on the surface-pinned 2D-in-3D plate

station_pillar.name: Station Pillar (corner column)
station_pillar.description: A grid-modular square column claiming one cell, with a lit accent groove and base/capital — frames a station's corners.

parameters.post_width: Shaft width, fits inside a 1 m cell (default 0.42)
parameters.chamfer: Chamfer on base + capital edges (0 = square, larger = tapered)
parameters.readout_face: Small framed readout on the +Z face (bool)
parameters.cap_style: plate | stepped | bevel — capital + base crown style
parameters.flute_count: Vertical flutes per face (0 = single inset panel)
parameters.bolts: Bolt rows on foot corners + capital underside (bool)
parameters.caution_stripe: Diagonal caution-stripe kick band at the base (bool)
parameters.dust: Faint vertical dust streaks down the front face (bool)
parameters.stencil_text: Painted stencil text on the shaft (empty = none)

curation_station.name: Curation Station (composer)
curation_station.description: The composer: give it 1-5 artifact lookup-names and it assembles a whole curation bay on the 1 m grid — step-stage, a plinth per item, a tiling backing wall with caps, framing pillars, and each artifact grounded inert on its plinth.

parameters.artifacts: Array of 1-5 artifact lookup-names to curate
parameters.layout: Bay shape: row (default, a front-facing line) | corner (an L — two walls, plinths along both legs)

station_cabinet.name: Station Cabinet (storage / display)
station_cabinet.description: A grid-modular display/storage cabinet (width_cells x 1 m) with a tinted glass front and lit internal shelves — cabinets line up cell-to-cell as a glowing back wall of stored specimens.

parameters.width_cells: Cabinet width in 1 m cells (int, default 2)

station_barrier.name: Station Barrier (front rail)
station_barrier.description: A grid-modular front barrier (length_cells x 1 m) of posts with a low panel or rail and a caution base — marks the front edge of the stage: stand back, look, do not cross.

parameters.length_cells: Run length in 1 m cells (int, default 4)

station_panel.name: Station Panel (wall info screen)
station_panel.description: A grid-modular wall-mounted info panel (width_cells x 1 m) showing crisp 2D-in-3D text (a title + lines) on a dark face — mounts flat on a station_wall to caption the bay.

parameters.width_cells: Panel width in 1 m cells (int, default 2)

station_bench.name: Station Bench (workbench)
station_bench.description: A grid-modular worktable (length_cells x depth_cells) with a top at working height, apron, legs, and optional drawers — the flat way to present a set, laid out rather than raised on plinths.

parameters.length_cells: Bench length in 1 m cells (int, default 2)
parameters.depth_cells: Bench depth in 1 m cells (int, default 1)

station_crates.name: Station Crates (supply stack)
station_crates.description: A grid-modular cluster of stacked crates and a canister with hazard labels, filling one cell — the lived-in back-of-house clutter that makes a clean stage believable.

station_ascent.name: Station Ascent (passage up)
station_ascent.description: The station kit's PASSAGE piece — a painted-metal way up onto a tall stage or between heights, built as a flight of treads (stair), two stiles + rungs (ladder), or an inclined deck (ramp) sized to rise. Worn treads, an emissive nosing line per step edge, an optional handrail. Origin at the foot; the top of the run lands at rise.

parameters.rise: Total height to climb in metres — the top of the run lands here (default 1.0)
parameters.style: stair (flight of treads) | ladder (stiles + rungs) | ramp (inclined deck)
parameters.width: Clear width of the climb in metres — tread width / rung span / ramp deck width (default 1.0)
parameters.handrail: A handrail (posts + top rail) running up the climb (bool, default true)
parameters.stringers: Worn-metal side stringers / rails framing the run (bool)
parameters.nosing_light: Emissive nosing line on each step edge / rung / ramp lip (bool)
parameters.hazard_foot: Diagonal caution-stripe kick band on the foot landing (bool)
parameters.body_color: Painted-metal body colour as r,g,b,a string
parameters.tread_color: Worn-metal tread / rung / deck colour as r,g,b,a string
parameters.accent_color: Emissive nosing accent as r,g,b,a string (Braun-orange by default)

station_floorline.name: Station Floorline (processional strip)
station_floorline.description: A flush floor element (~2 cm proud) that connects rather than isolates — a lit strip you read with your feet. Three styles: 'line' (a single lit groove joining two bays), 'path' (a dashed runner with directional chevrons), 'threshold' (a wider crossing bar with end ticks). direction points the chevrons along +X / none / -X. The kit's first piece about between, not on — laid between two curated bays to make the walk legible.

parameters.length_cells: Length of the run in 1 m cells along +X (joins one bay to the next)
parameters.width: Strip width across Z in metres (~0.2 broad-line to ~0.6 processional bar)
parameters.direction: Chevron direction: 1 = toward +X, -1 = toward -X, 0 = no chevrons
parameters.accent_color: Lit accent colour as an 'r,g,b,a' string

station_luminaire.name: Station Luminaire (light fixture)
station_luminaire.description: The station kit's only source of light — a painted-metal Dieter-Rams fixture carrying a REAL Godot light. mode=task is an aimed SpotLight3D on a gooseneck arm leaning over one focal bay; mode=area is a soft OmniLight3D in a hung housing dropped on a thin rod over a whole bay. Origin at the floor; it acts ON the other props by lighting them, not beside them.

parameters.mode: task (aimed SpotLight on a gooseneck over a focal bay) | area (soft OmniLight in a hung housing)
parameters.height: Mount height in metres — gooseneck post top (task) or ceiling plane the housing hangs from (area)
parameters.light_color: Light + lens colour as a string 'r,g,b,a'
parameters.warm: true = warm tungsten bias, false = cool clinical white
parameters.arm_reach: How far the gooseneck arm reaches out over the work in metres (task mode)

station_multiscreen.name: Station Multiscreen (convergence panel)
station_multiscreen.description: A wall-mounted painted-metal panel divided into an R x C grid of 2D-in-3D readout cells, each its own captioned face, behind one shared bezel and header strip — for the four-views / convergence capstones a single station_panel can't hold. 1x2 = before/after, 2x2 = four views, 1xN = a filmstrip of stages. Mounts flat on a station_wall (front face +Z, wall:true when placed).

parameters.rows: Number of cell rows (top to bottom)
parameters.cols: Number of cell columns (left to right)
parameters.cell_labels: Array of short captions, ROW-MAJOR (one per cell, left-to-right then top-to-bottom)
parameters.header: Title shown on the header strip across the whole lattice
parameters.accent_color: Header accent line + title tint ("r,g,b,a" string)

station_skydome.name: Station Skydome (atmosphere backdrop)
station_skydome.description: A large UNLIT/emissive backdrop — an inward-facing bowed shell set BEHIND a bay as void or sky — for artifacts that have no scale (the dark_sphere / fractal clouds the curators had to float base-free). A vertical top_color→bottom_color gradient that reads as air, never a surface; stands depth_offset back along -Z. Where a plinth says 'this one, here', the skydome gives a thing with no edge a sky to hang in.

parameters.width_cells: Backdrop width in 1 m grid cells (int, default 8)
parameters.height: Backdrop height in metres — top of the shell above the floor (default 6.0)
parameters.mode: void (flat dark field) | sky (two stacked bands + soft seam) | gradient (smooth vertical fade)
parameters.top_color: Top of the vertical gradient as 'r,g,b,a' (default 0.05,0.07,0.12)
parameters.bottom_color: Bottom of the vertical gradient as 'r,g,b,a' (default 0.02,0.02,0.03)
parameters.depth_offset: How far back the shell stands along -Z in metres (default 4.0)
parameters.curve: How much the shell bows toward the viewer at its edges, metres (0 = flat plane, default 1.6)
parameters.segments: Vertical strips across the width — more = smoother curve + gradient (default 14)
parameters.glow: Emissive energy — how brightly the backdrop self-lights (default 0.85)
